title: PayPal Mafia network pass
summary: Evidence-separated mapping of the informal PayPal alumni network, its corporate origin, successor ventures, investment links, and a correction audit of the supplied infographic.

sources.title: eBay Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2002 Financial Results

data.method: Primary-source-first entity and relation extraction; the uploaded infographic was used only to identify leads.
data.evidence_rule: Founding, employment, investment, board service, acquisition, and informal-network membership are encoded as separate predicates.

caveats: The PayPal Mafia is an informal media and alumni label, not a legal organization or proof of coordinated control.
